jobs.occupation: Sales Enablement Lead Hybrids (m/f/d) (Berater/in - Erneuerbare Energien)
jobs.description: ENERCON GmbHAt ENERCON, we are combining wind energy and battery storage into integrated hybrid energy systems. To scale our Wind+Storage business, we are looking for a Sales Enablement Lead who can turn grid-scale BESS expertise into practical sales tools, consistent proposals, and clear contracting standards.Your Mission:As Sales Enablement Lead Hybrids (m/f/d), you will be the primary interface within the Solution Line Hybrids for the Head of Technical Sales, who has overall responsibility for Wind+Storage sales. Together, you will establish the sales process from opportunity qualification and initial BESS sizing through proposal development and contracting. You will build the tools and standards that support this process and define a structured handover from Sales to Project Management.You will work closely with the Global Growth Lead within the Solution Line Hybrids to match pipeline projects with suitable contractors and suppliers. While the Global Growth Lead acts as the primary interface to Global Procurement, you will bring customer requirements and proposed offer commitments into the matching process. Together, you will ensure that what ENERCON offers customers aligns with what Global Procurement can source and suppliers can deliver.Your Responsibilities:- Establish and continuously improve the Wind+Storage sales process together with the Head of Technical Sales, defining clear roles, review steps, and deliverables from opportunity qualification through contracting.- Build and maintain technical sales tools for preliminary BESS sizing and configuration, proposal development, and documentation of assumptions and scope boundaries.- Develop standard contract templates and technical schedules with the Head of Technical Sales, Legal, and Engineering, covering scope, performance guarantees, acceptance criteria, and Divisions of Responsibility (DoRs).- Equip regional wind sales teams to qualify and develop standard Wind+Storage opportunities through practical training, playbooks, qualification checklists, and reusable proposal materials.- Define clear criteria with the Head of Technical Sales for when regional teams can proceed independently and when specialist input is needed. Support complex opportunities that require expert review of BESS configurations, customer requirements, or proposed contract commitments.- Partner with the Global Growth Lead on project-to-supplier matching. Bring customer requirements, sizing assumptions, and proposed contract commitments into the assessment so that offers reflect the scope, interfaces, performance, and delivery timelines suppliers can commit to.- Define a structured handover to Project Management so that the agreed technical scope, contractual commitments, assumptions, interfaces, and open risks are documented and transferred at contract award.- Use feedback from regional teams, bids, negotiations, and project handovers to improve sales processes, tools, and contracting standards.Your Profile:- Several years of hands-on experience with grid-scale BESS, including technical sizing and configuration for customer projects. You understand how use cases, grid connection limits, and operating requirements translate into power and energy ratings and performance requirements.- Practical experience in technical sales and contracting for grid-scale BESS projects, including proposal development, scope definition, and negotiation of technical or commercial contract terms.- Familiarity with BESS performance guarantees, acceptance criteria, and Divisions of Responsibility (DoRs), and the ability to translate technical assumptions into clear offer and contract language.- University degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Business Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a comparable field.- Experience building repeatable sales processes, technical sales tools, or standard proposal and contract documentation for complex energy or infrastructure projects.- Experience equipping regional sales teams to sell complex technical solutions, for example through training, practical tools, or coaching on customer opportunities.- Ability to work across Sales, Engineering, Procurement, Legal, and Project Management, and to explain technical trade-offs clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.- Fluent in English; German language skills are an advantage.- Willingness to travel internationally.What Makes This Role Special:You will shape how ENERCON sizes, offers, and contracts Wind+Storage projects. Working alongside the Head of Technical Sales, you will build a sales process that regional wind sales teams can use across markets, giving them more ownership of standard opportunities while allowing Technical Sales to focus its expertise where it adds the most value.By bringing supplier capabilities into the offer process early and making customer commitments clear at handover, you will help ensure that what Sales promises, Procurement sources, and Project Management delivers fit together.Why ENERCON?- Shape the future of renewable energy through innovative Wind+Storage solutions.- Work in a highly international and collaborative environment.- Take ownership of a strategically important global function with high visibility across the organization.- Contribute directly to the growth of sustainable energy systems and the global energy transition.- Join a company with decades of experience and technological leadership in renewable energy.Ready to shape how ENERCON sells and contracts Wind+Storage solutions? We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.occupation: Global Growth Lead Hybrids (m/f/d) (Berater/in - Erneuerbare Energien)
jobs.description: ENERCON GmbHInnovative ideas are the foundation of our success. At ENERCON, we are driving the energy transition by combining wind energy and battery storage solutions into scalable, sustainable hybrid power systems. Join us in shaping the next generation of renewable energy solutions and supporting customers worldwide on their path to a carbon-neutral future.Your Mission:As Global Growth Lead Hybrids (m/f/d), you will be the primary interface between the Solution Line Hybrids and Global Procurement. You will work closely with the Sales Enablement Lead within the Solution Line Hybrids to create a back-to-back process between BESS sales and procurement. Together with Global Procurement, Engineering, and Project Delivery, you will translate project requirements into supplier needs and assess which partners can deliver the required scope.Over the medium term, you will help prepare ENERCON's hybrid business for expansion into new markets. You will assess market attractiveness, work with regional teams on go-to-market plans, and apply lessons from Germany to adapt our supplier setup and delivery model to local conditions.Your Responsibilities:- Act as the primary point of contact for Global Procurement within the Solution Line Hybrids, translating pipeline demand into clear supplier requirements and priorities.- Partner closely with the Sales Enablement Lead to match pipeline projects with suitable BESS EPC contractors and system integrators, ensuring that customer offers reflect the scope, responsibilities, and delivery timelines that suppliers can commit to.- Work with Global Procurement and technical teams to evaluate BESS EPC contractors and system integrators, assessing relevant project references, technical capabilities, scope coverage, and delivery capability.- Collaborate with Engineering and Project Delivery to define and review Divisions of Responsibility (DoRs) across the BESS scope, electrical balance of plant (eBoP), and civil balance of plant (cBoP), identifying scope gaps, overlaps, and interface risks.- Maintain a clear view of upcoming project needs, supplier readiness, and gaps in supplier coverage to support procurement planning and project decisions.- Assess the attractiveness of future markets for Wind+Storage, considering customer demand, market conditions, routes to market, and local supplier and delivery capabilities.- Develop go-to-market plans with regional teams and coordinate market-entry preparations, including identifying local partners and assessing what is needed to deliver the first projects.- Capture lessons from German projects and adapt proven approaches to supplier evaluation, scope definition, and project delivery for new markets.Your Profile:- Several years of hands-on experience with grid-scale BESS projects, ideally in supplier selection, project development, contracting, or delivery.- University degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Business Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a comparable field.- Experience evaluating BESS EPC contractors and system integrators is a strong advantage, particularly in assessing technical and commercial fit, project references, and delivery capability.- Deep understanding of electrical and civil balance of plant (eBoP and cBoP) and practical experience working with Divisions of Responsibility (DoRs) to define scope boundaries and interfaces.- Experience with market assessment, go-to-market planning, or market entry in the energy or infrastructure sector is an advantage.- Experience working across procurement, engineering, sales, and project delivery, ideally in an international environment.- Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to turn technical and commercial assessments into clear recommendations.- Fluent in English; German language skills are an advantage.- Willingness to travel internationally.What Makes This Role SpecialYou will help determine which partners ENERCON works with to deliver Wind+Storage projects and how responsibilities are shared. jobs.occupation: PhD Student in iPSC Disease Modeling and Gene Therapies (f/m/d) (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: The Stem Cell Unit (https://umg.eu/scu) is dedicated to advancing precision medicine by applying patient-specific induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) disease models. We generate and utilize iPSCs for cutting-edge research in genome editing, cardiac differentiation, tissue engineering, and disease modeling. By combining iPSC technology with CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing and state-of-the-art molecular and functional approaches, we investigate the pathophysiology of cardiomyocytes at genomic, omics, functional, and pharmacological levels. Our ultimate goal is to uncover novel mechanisms driving cardiomyopathy and heart failure and to translate these insights into personalized therapeutics and innovative gene therapies. We are seeking a highly motivated PhD student who is eager to work at the interdisciplinary interface between basic research and translational medicine. In this role, you will establish advanced iPSC-based cardiac models and apply them in imaging-driven and functional high-throughput screening assays to identify novel therapeutic strategies.Your tasks- you will develop 2D and cardiac organoid models based on human iPSCs to study cardiovascular diseases- you will use CRISPR/Cas9 for the targeted genetic modification of iPSCs- you will produce AAV vectors for preclinical testing- you will establish suitable screening methods for imaging-based analysis- you will apply preclinical compound screenings and test AAV-based gene strategies to identify novel therapeuticsYour qualifications- university degree (Master or equivalent) in disciplines or fields related to biology, pharmacology or biochemistry- strong interest in stem cell research, genome editing, gene therapies, and cardiovascular medicine- first hands-on experiences in human iPSC culture, CRISPR/Cas technology, and general molecular biology- excellent written and spoken English; German is not required but considered an advantageWe offer- access to state-of-the-art infrastructure for stem cell research, genome editing, advanced imaging, and multi-omics analyses- an inspiring, interdisciplinary, and international research environment with strong translational focus- close collaboration with clinical and basic science groups within the University Medical Center Göttingen, Fraunhofer, and national/international consortia, as well as participation in the German Centers for Health Research (DZHK, DZNE, DZKJ)- an attractive research location in Göttingen, a vibrant hub of biomedical and cardiovascular research in Germany- support for career development, including mentoring, grant writing, leadership training, and opportunities to present at international conferences- a family-friendly workplace with flexible working hours
